description:
Is this mortgage offer good? Grades a written offer (rate, points, lender fees) A–D against the live Optimal Blue index of actual locked rates for the same product, term, credit score and LTV. Returns spread vs market in basis points, monthly and total cost vs market over the expected holding period, and a plain-language verdict with next step.
Price: $0.50 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana).

lender_fees.description: Lender origination/underwriting fees in USD, excluding third-party costs (default 0)

points.description: Discount points as percent of loan; negative for lender credits (default 0)

rate.description: Offered note rate in percent, e.g. 6.875

years_in_home.description: Years the borrower expects to keep the loan (default 7)

name: grade_mortgage_offer
title: Mortgage Offer Grader
